name: hud-levelup
note: The HUD at the screen's corners (hud_edges) through a level up mid fight, locked on to an armoured knight of room 5.12. The game keeps its message box flag up for seconds after a level up while the fight goes on, and the whole HUD went back to the 4:3 middle until it was down (a player's report: 'the hud will change from 16:9 to 4:3 mid battle using Lock On'). Now the HUD's pieces keep their moves while a box is up (widescreen.cpp). wide.hud is the HUD sheet's widest draw, the health bar's frame.

steps.until: room == 12 and player.active and not loading and not cutscene

steps.note: fought until Hector's level up (two knights): its flag up, the health bar still at the corner
the fight goes on under the flag
